items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Sidney was on the bandstand... Nichol said, 'Pete Johnson can't go... Do you know anyone... Sidney Bechet told Nichole Barclay... And so I said, 'Okay.' 'Here's his ticket.'

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Pete Johnson, the boogie-woogie pianist. Pete Johnson couldn't go, he couldn't get out of his contracts up in Albany, New York, and so Nichol heard the conversation because I was on the bandstand and Sidney was on the bandstand, we were getting ready to play our set, and Nichol said, 'Pete Johnson can't go. I have an extra ticket. Do you know anyone . . .' (end of Side 1)

So Nichole asked Sidney, 'Do you know of anybody that we could take, I got an extra ticket, that would leave an impression in Parisian audiences?' And he pointed right straight to me, 'Take him, he'll account for himself.' That's what Sidney Bechet told Nichole Barclay. And so I said, 'Okay.' 'Here's his ticket.'
